docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
An orphan girl comes by mistake to Green Gables on Prince Edward Island.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

L. M. Montgomery (1874–1942), Anne of Green Gables, 1908. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
